```{r library, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# Use the grkmisc theme
theme_set(
  grkmisc::theme_grk(
    base_family = "Source Serif Pro",
    axis_text_family = "Source Code Pro",
    axis_title_family = "Source Serif Pro",
    default_geom_font = "Source Sans Pro",
    use_showtext = TRUE
  ) + 
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
)
```

<!-- load data --> 
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

datpath <- here::here("data", "20200522", "c16_170_IRONMAN_535_20200515_173636")
files <- dir(datpath, pattern = "*.sas7bdat")
# this one has a problem right now
files <- files[-which(files %in% c("new_pq_v5.sas7bdat", "newdisc_pqv5.sas7bdat"))]
dat <- files %>% 
  file.path(datpath, .) %>% 
  set_names(str_replace(files, ".sas7bdat", "")) %>%
  map(haven::read_sas) 
```

## Delivered data sets
IRONMAN data are delivered in a series of `r length(files)` files in `.sas7bdat` format. Here is a current summary of those files, the number of rows/columns in each, and the number of unique patient IDs, as identified by `subjectId`.
```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dat %>% map_dfr(~ summarize(.,
                            nRows=n(),
                            nVariables=ncol(.),
                            uniqueIDs=n_distinct(subjectId))) %>%
  bind_cols(tibble(Data=names(dat)), .) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

datJoin <- dat %>% reduce(full_join)
datLabels <- labelled::var_label(datJoin)
```
Following a merge of all `r length(dat)` data sets, we have a data frame with `r nrow(datJoin)` rows representing `r n_distinct(datJoin$subjectId)` patients and `r ncol(datJoin)` variables. 

## Individual data set summaries {.tabset}

```{r results="asis", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
dat %>% 
  discard(~nrow(.) < 1) %>%
  iwalk(~ {
    cat("\n### ", .y, "\n\nVariable summaries, stratified by variable type:")
    labelled::var_label(.x) %>% 
      map_dfr(~tibble(label=.), .id="variable") %>%
      left_join(skimr::skim_to_wide(.x)) %>% 
      split(.$type) %>% 
      map(janitor::remove_empty, which="cols") %>% 
      map(~kable(.) %>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)) %>%
      walk(print)
    cat("The first 6 rows in this data file:")
    kable(head(.x)) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) %>% print()
  })
```
